state.document: A written order from the army commander to the generals of his army.
state.order: The whole army stands fast where it is on the heights; nobody is to descend to pursue.
formations of this army: Imperial Army (General Daun); also called the army, the Imperial army, the Austrian army, the headquarters, my headquarters, the King, the Feldmarschall
Andlau's division (infantry); also called Andlau
Angern's brigade (infantry); also called Angern
Artillery (artillery, General Feuerstein); also called the artillery, the Austrian guns, the heavy batteries, Feuerstein's guns
Babocsay's hussars (cavalry); also called Babocsay's brigade
Benedikt Daun's cavalry (cavalry); also called first-line cavalry of the right, Trauttmansdorff's brigade
Beck's flank guard (infantry); also called Beck's Croats, the left flank guard, Beck's brigade
Castiglione's brigade (cavalry); also called Castiglione
Centre infantry (infantry, General Marschall); also called the centre, the Austrian infantry, Marschall's infantry, the main line
Erdödy's hussars (cavalry); also called Erdödy's brigade
Esterházy's brigade (infantry, General Esterházy (GM)); also called Esterházy's infantry
Gemmingen's brigade (infantry); also called Gemmingen
Grenadier reserve (infantry, General Grenadier reserve commander (unrecorded)); also called the grenadiers, the Austrian grenadiers
Grenzer in the villages (infantry, General Grenzer post commanders (unrecorded)); also called the Croats, the Grenzer, the village garrisons
Hadik's division (cavalry); also called Hadik
Köbel's brigade (cavalry); also called Köbel
Kolowrat's cavalry (cavalry); also called first-line cavalry of the left
Krottendorf's brigade (infantry); also called Krottendorf
Lützow's division (cavalry); also called Lützow, the reserve cavalry
Left-wing cavalry (cavalry, General Stampach); also called the left-wing cavalry, Stampach's cavalry, the cavalry of the left
Mayern's brigade (infantry); also called Mayern
Morocz's division (cavalry); also called Morocz
Müffling's brigade (infantry); also called Müffling
Nádasdy's corps; also called the right flank corps, Nadasdy's corps, the light horse, Nádasdy's cavalry
Saxon chevaux-légers (cavalry, General Nostitz); also called the Saxons, the Saxon cavalry, Nostitz's brigade, Benkendorf
O'Donell's division (cavalry); also called O'Donell, O'Donell's cavalry
Pálffy's hussars (cavalry); also called Pálffy's brigade
Plonquet's brigade (infantry); also called Plonquet
Puebla's division (infantry); also called Puebla
Reichlin's brigade (infantry); also called Reichlin
Reserve (General Colloredo); also called the reserve, Colloredo's reserve
Right-wing cavalry (cavalry, General Serbelloni); also called the right-wing cavalry, Serbelloni's cavalry, the cuirassiers of the right
Schröger's hussars (cavalry); also called Schröger's brigade
Sincère's division (infantry); also called Sincère, Sincere's division
Starhemberg's division (infantry); also called Starhemberg's infantry, the second line infantry
Kommandierte cavalry (cavalry, General Starhemberg (GM)); also called the picked horse, the Kommandierten, Starhemberg's picked cavalry
Széchényi's hussars (cavalry); also called Széchényi's brigade
Wied's division (infantry); also called Wied, Wied's infantry
Wöllwarth's division (cavalry); also called Wöllwarth
Wulffen's brigade (infantry); also called Wulffen

o0.instructions: Read the order. Apart from what the whole army is told to do, does it give Artillery (artillery, General Feuerstein); also called the artillery, the Austrian guns, the heavy batteries, Feuerstein's guns an instruction of its own: is this formation or its general named, or meant by its arm ('the cavalry', 'the guns'), and given something particular to do?

criteria.true: yes, it has an instruction of its own
criteria.false: no, it is only part of the whole army's instruction
